seam: logos CompoundTheory decision+identity vector v1 (UNFROZEN v1)
note: Language-AGNOSTIC tri-core vector for the CompoundTheory composed of [arithmetic, text] IN THAT ORDER. Each core builds CompoundTheory over [ArithmeticTheory, TextTheory] and MUST reproduce the pinned identity + owns + decisions byte-for-byte (the §7 dual-conformance / byte-parity law). identity.config_digest is a length-prefixed SHA-256 over the ORDERED member identities (logos-core/arithmetic-theory@1.0.0 and logos-core/text-theory@1.0.0, both zero config), domain-separated by 'logos-core/compound-theory/v1\n' — so the digest commits to membership AND order (the swapped order has a different digest). owns is the UNION of the members' predicates; decide routes each predicate to the FIRST owning member (the members own disjoint sets, so 'first' is 'the' owner). Arg encodings match vectors/arithmetic.json + vectors/text.json: {atom}=bare Atom of UTF-8 bytes, {int}=ontos-data int embedding, {op}=operator compound Tuple(Atom(op), arg..), {text}=utf8-text embedding (a Tuple), {tuple}=raw Tuple.

decisions.name: routes_to_arith_is_holds
decisions.note: is/2 routes to the arithmetic member: 5 is 2 + 3

decisions.name: routes_to_arith_compare_fails
decisions.note: two non-int atoms -> the ARITHMETIC sub-code, proving =:= routed to arithmetic (not text)

decisions.name: routes_to_text_contains_hit
decisions.note: contains routes to the text member: 'foobar' contains 'oba'

decisions.name: routes_to_text_contains_miss
decisions.note: absent -> the TEXT sub-code, proving contains routed to text (not arithmetic)

decisions.name: routes_to_text_bad_arity
decisions.note: contains/1 -> text bad arity (routed to text, which owns the arity-error band)
